{"number":1945,"title":"Serialize the function result, not the whole FunctionResultContent, in ToContentBlock","body":"`ToContentBlock` on a `FunctionResultContent` whose `Result` is not an `AIContent` builds the text block from the whole `FunctionResultContent` instead of from `Result`, so the text is a JSON object with `$type`, `result` and `callId` in it rather than the tool's output.

Through `SampleAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage>, ...)` / `AsSamplingChatClient()` with `UseFunctionInvocation()`, a local tool's result reaches the client as `{"$type":"functionResult","result":"Weather in Paris: ...","callId":"call_weather_123"}`, and that is what the client's model reads. That path is `[Obsolete]` with the rest of sampling, but `ToContentBlock` itself is public and not obsolete, so any caller converting a function result hits the same thing.

The fix serializes `resultContent.Result`, the same way `AIFunctionMcpServerTool` turns a non-content return value into text. `StructuredContent` was already taken from `Result`, so the two now agree.

`EndToEnd_SamplingWithTools_...` already goes through this path, but it only asserts that the text contains "Weather in Paris: sunny", which the wrapped JSON also does. I added one `DoesNotContain("callId")` line there, plus unit tests for a string result, a `JsonElement` result and an `AIContent` result (the last one is unchanged behaviour).

One thing you may want differently: a string result that comes through as a `JsonElement` still ends up quoted (`"Weather in Paris: ..."`), the same as a tool returning a `JsonElement` string today. I kept it consistent with that path rather than unwrapping strings here, but happy to change it if you prefer.

Tests pass on net10.0, net9.0, net8.0 and net472.","state":"open","draft":false,"merged":false,"mergeable_state":"blocked","html_url":"https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/csharp-sdk/pull/1945","user":{"login":"dfedoryshchev","id":64079946,"profile_url":"https://github.com/dfedoryshchev","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/64079946?v=4"},"head":{"ref":"fix/function-result-content-text","sha":"ccfd0924a06f070fefa7beb7ae671c9fb3c0e372","repo":{"full_name":"dfedoryshchev/csharp-sdk","description":"The official C# SDK for Model Context Protocol servers and clients.
